limits: Analysis only; no arithmetic archives, finite-codec improvement, counted package or prize qualification.

Original S probabilities, raw inverse and introduced-state witnesses replay exactly, but new expert distributions intentionally omit original inactive-slot weights and persistent/outer posteriors. New early arm is a selection control, not historical I or S.
All-paired versus early isolates cap; all-retained additionally removes pair eligibility. Neither changes source history capacity or freeze schedule.
Exact stored-prefix matching is a conservative transfer: no alternative WRT encoding synthesis, edited spelling, dictionary-code prefix predictor or future-event access.

Reported scan and byte comparisons exclude allocator/parser/state-serialization work; explicit pair-loop checks and guarded process resources are recorded. Diagnostic implementation rescans rather than optimizing an index.
Geometry has no cost credit inside an already-completed whole-word emission. Candidate suffix lengths describe still-unknown modeled positions, not proof those donors are correct.

policy.ceiling: Parent bit cost on each prospective set grants perfect prediction, not achievable savings. Never add overlapping subsets.
policy.decision: Require E_pool ceiling>=256 bits and full-population all-pool expert cost below both parent and early expert to support further transfer work. Otherwise stop this transfer; retain conditional attribution. 256 is a planning threshold, not futility theorem.
policy.discovery: Distinct additional donor end coordinates per mention and epoch; remaining_min/max are causal candidate suffix lengths, not future-confirmed truth lengths.
policy.distribution: Uniform over matching donors, each emits rounded half-parent/half-copy binary distribution. Empty set equals parent. Common rule, no persistent binding or outer mixture in any new shadow arm.
policy.geometry: Completed title/body words of at least3 letters, classified ex post by number of inverse emissions; geometry does not select cost events.
policy.history: Sealed v2 exact parser, FIFO64 per role, word caps32 modeled/64 raw, publication after delimiter, same4096-modeled-byte frozen pools. No new page resets.
policy.opportunities: E_cap and E_pair are prospective additional-match sets, can overlap; E_pool is their union. Include every selected event even when prediction is wrong or actual next emission is a delimiter.
policy.population: Previously exposed raw[0,250000); retained parent trace only. Zero tuning. No validation or confirmation access.
policy.selection: Only after nonempty raw word prefix is decoder-visible; exact raw prefix and complete modeled prefix plus prior bits must match, and donor must have remaining raw and modeled spelling. No current truth argument.
